mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy combined with slow economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with slow growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it suggests a supply-side slowdown coupled with labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: supply-side slowdown with labor market weakness
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
